risk_factors.heading: Our current and future warranty reserves may be insufficient to cover future warranty claims.
risk_factors.quote: If our warranty reserves are inadequate to cover future warranty claims on our products, our financial condition and operating results may be harmed.

risk_factors.heading: Our insurance coverage strategy may not be adequate to protect us from all business risks.
risk_factors.quote: As a general matter, we do not maintain as much insurance coverage as many other companies do, and in some cases, we do not maintain any at all.

risk_factors.heading: Our debt agreements contain covenant restrictions that may limit our ability to operate our business.
risk_factors.quote: our failure to comply with our debt covenants could result in a default under our debt agreements, which could permit the holders to accelerate our obligation to repay the debt.

risk_factors.heading: Additional funds may not be available to us when we need or want them.
risk_factors.quote: We cannot be certain that additional funds will be available to us on favorable terms when required, or at all.

risk_factors.heading: We may be negatively impacted by any early obsolescence of our manufacturing and other equipment.
risk_factors.quote: product cycles or technology may change periodically, and we may decide to update our products or processes more quickly than expected.

risk_factors.heading: There is no guarantee that we will have sufficient cash flow from our business to pay our indebtedness or that we will not incur additional indebtedness.
risk_factors.quote: Our business may not continue to generate cash flow from operations in the future sufficient to satisfy our obligations under our existing indebtedness and any future indebtedness we may incur

risk_factors.heading: We are exposed to fluctuations in currency exchange rates.
risk_factors.quote: any strengthening of the U.S. dollar would tend to reduce our revenues as measured in U.S. dollars, as we have historically experienced.
